# unifi_protect_nvr_settings (Resource)

Console-wide UniFi Protect NVR settings — a **singleton** at `/proxy/protect/api/nvr`. Import/update-only: `terraform apply` configures the existing NVR, and `terraform destroy` removes it from state without changing the console (the NVR always exists). **Writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_retention_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the automatic recording-retention balancer is enabled.
- `disable_audio` (Boolean) Whether audio recording is disabled console-wide.
- `enable_automatic_backups` (Boolean) Whether automatic configuration backups are enabled.
- `name` (String) NVR / console display name.
- `recording_retention_duration_ms` (Number) Recording retention duration in milliseconds (used when `auto_retention_enabled` is false).
- `ssh_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSH access to the console is enabled.
- `temperature_unit` (String) Temperature unit: `C` or `F`.
- `time_format` (String) Clock format: `12h` or `24h`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`).

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Console management host/IP.
- `id` (String) Protect NVR object id.
- `version` (String) Running UniFi Protect application version.
